question: When embedding a request example in the docs, how do I specify which one to show if there are multiple? If the example has both a name and a summary, which one do I reference?
ground_truth: To reference a specific example when using the EndpointRequestSnippet component, use the `example` prop with the endpoint: `<EndpointRequestSnippet endpoint="PUT /pet" example="ExampleWithMarkley" />`. However, the value you provide depends on whether your example has a `summary` or `docs` field defined in the spec. If the example includes a `summary` or `docs` field, you must use that value for the `example` prop instead of the example name. If no summary is set, use the example name directly. So for an example with `name: "ExampleWithMarkley"` and `summary: "Complex Pet Update"`, you would use `example="Complex Pet Update"`. This can be confusing, so check your spec to see what metadata each example has - the summary/docs takes precedence over the name for referencing purposes.

### Directly reference the example

<Note title="Referencing examples">
  If the example includes a `summary` or `docs` field, use that for the `example` prop. If not summary is set, use the example name.
